# Campus Connect

> A unified college ERP, student engagement, and collaboration platform — attendance, lectures, gamified points, leaderboards, announcements and real-time notifications for institutions.

Campus Connect helps colleges run daily operations (lectures, attendance, results, documents) while keeping students engaged through points, streaks, achievements, leaderboards, and a digital ID. It ships as an installable PWA with offline-friendly caching and native web push.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview, features, and how Campus Connect modernizes campus operations.
